arxiv-2106-06396.title: Fluctuating Paths of Least Time, Schrödinger Equation, Van der Waals torque and Casimir Effect Mechanism
arxiv-2106-06396.creator: F. Ben Adda
arxiv-2106-06396.description: Abstract The use of an infinity of fluctuating paths of least time that are compatible with the quantum mechanics indeterminacy provides a new interpretation in geometrical optic of the interference pattern of Young’s double slit experiment, which suggests that the wave behavior of matter and radiation is dictated by the space-time geodesics.

arxiv-2203-07326.title: On the strong convergence of the Faedo-Galerkin approximations to a strong T-periodic solution of the torso-coupled bi-domain model
arxiv-2203-07326.creator: Raul Felipe-Sosa, Andres Fraguela-Collar, Yofre H. García-Gómez
arxiv-2203-07326.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the convergence of the Faedo-Galerkin approximations, in a strong sense, to a strong T-periodic solution of the torso-coupled bidomain model where T T is the period of activation of the inner wall of heart. First, we define the torso-coupled bi-domain operator and prove some of its more important properties for our work.

arxiv-2209-07430.title: Machine Reading, Fast and Slow: When Do Models “Understand” Language?
arxiv-2209-07430.creator: Sagnik Ray Choudhury, Anna Rogers, Isabelle Augenstein
arxiv-2209-07430.description: Abstract Two of the most fundamental challenges in Natural Language Understanding (NLU) at present are: (a) how to establish whether deep learning-based models score highly on NLU benchmarks for the ‘right’ reasons; and (b) to understand what those reasons would even be. We investigate the behavior of reading comprehension models with respect to two linguistic ‘skills’: coreference resolution and comparison.

arxiv-2404-12660.title: Search for the non-resonant production of Higgs boson pairs via gluon fusion and vector-boson fusion in the b ​ b ¯ ​ τ + ​ τ − b\bar{b}\tau^{+}\tau^{-} final state in proton–proton collisions at s = 13 \sqrt{s}=13 TeV with the ATLAS detector
arxiv-2404-12660.description: Abstract A search for the non-resonant production of Higgs boson pairs in the H ​ H → b ​ b ¯ ​ τ + ​ τ − HH\rightarrow b\bar{b}\tau^{+}\tau^{-} channel is performed using 140 fb -1 of proton–proton collisions at a centre-of-mass energy of 13 13 TeV recorded by the ATLAS detector at the CERN Large Hadron Collider.

arxiv-2404-19089.title: Electronic correlations, layer distinction, and electron doping in the alternating single-layer trilayer La 3 Ni 2 O 7 polymorph
arxiv-2404-19089.creator: Harrison LaBollita, Soumen Bag, Jesse Kapeghian, Antia S. Botana
arxiv-2404-19089.description: Abstract We employ a density-functional theory plus dynamical mean-field theory framework to investigate the correlated electronic structure of the alternating single-layer trilayer (1313) polymorph of La 3 Ni 2 O 7 , that becomes superconducting under pressure. At ambient pressure, the single-layer is in a Mott insulating regime and the low-energy physics is dominated by the trilayer block.

arxiv-2407-10669.title: Probing-Enhanced Stochastic Programming
arxiv-2407-10669.creator: Zhichao Ma, Youngdae Kim, Jeff Linderoth, James R. Luedtke, Logan R. Matthews
arxiv-2407-10669.description: Abstract We consider a two-stage stochastic decision problem where the decision-maker has the opportunity to obtain information about the distribution of the random variables 𝝃 \bm{\xi} that appear in the problem through a set of discrete actions that we refer to as probing .

arxiv-2410-06262.title: SymDiff: Equivariant Diffusion via Stochastic Symmetrisation
arxiv-2410-06262.creator: Leo Zhang Kianoosh Ashouritaklimi Yee Whye Teh Rob Cornish
arxiv-2410-06262.description: Abstract We propose SymDiff , a method for constructing equivariant diffusion models using the framework of stochastic symmetrisation. SymDiff resembles a learned data augmentation that is deployed at sampling time, and is lightweight, computationally efficient, and easy to implement on top of arbitrary off-the-shelf models.

arxiv-2503-17346.title: Abundances of refractory ions in Beta Pictoris exocomets
arxiv-2503-17346.creator: T. Vrignaud, A. Lecavelier des Etangs, P. A. Strøm, F. Kiefer
arxiv-2503-17346.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by T. Vrignaud, A. Lecavelier des Etangs, P. A. Strøm, F. Kiefer. β \beta Pictoris is a young, A5V star, known for harbouring a large number of cometary-like object (or exocomets) which frequently transit the star and create variable absorption signatures in its spectrum. The physical and chemical properties of these exocomets can be probed by the recently introduced curve of growth approach, which enables column densities measurements in cometary tails using absorption measurements in numerous spectral lines.

arxiv-2506-22400.creator: Pierre Descombes
arxiv-2506-22400.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Pierre Descombes. In this paper we prove a toric localization formula in the cohomological Donaldson-Thomas theory. arxiv-2511-18467.title: Shadows in the Code: Exploring the Risks and Defenses of LLM-based Multi-Agent Software Development Systems
arxiv-2511-18467.creator: Xiaoqing Wang, Keman Huang, Bin Liang, Hongyu Li, Xiaoyong Du
arxiv-2511-18467.description: Abstract The rapid advancement of Large Language Model (LLM)-driven multi-agent systems has significantly streamlined software developing tasks, enabling users with little technical expertise to develop executable applications. While these systems democratize software creation through natural language requirements, they introduce significant security risks that remain largely unexplored.

europmc-pmc5968375.description: Immune cell function and metabolism are closely linked. Many studies have now clearly demonstrated that alterations in cellular metabolism influence immune cell function and that, conversely, immune cell function determines the cellular metabolic state. Less well understood,...

pmc-11811718.title: Predictive value of miR-582-5p for onset of sepsis-induced acute kidney injury and its functional role during disease development
pmc-11811718.creator: Yuhong Zhao, Yuan Li, Mei Su, Xiaoyue Cai
pmc-11811718.description: IntroductionAcute kidney injury (AKI) is a common complication of sepsis, characterized by sharply declining renal function. As a global concern, understanding its pathogenesis and improving diagnosis and therapy face significant challenges. MicroRNAs are involved in the progression of a variety of diseases.This research was focused on differences in expression and clinical predictive value of miR-582-5p in sepsis-induced AKI.

pmc-12410541.title: Development and Application of the WFS-175: A Novel Multidimensional Score for Wrist Function
pmc-12410541.creator: Sang Anh Nguyen, Doanh Quoc Tran
pmc-12410541.description: PurposeWe present a novel protocol for wrist function assessment that integrates both objective factors (range of motion and grip strength) and subjective domains (pain, motor function, and quality of life) into the composite Wrist Function Score - 175 (WFS-175) score.

pmc-12469574.title: Pharmacogenetics Approach for Personalized Tacrolimus Dosing in Heart Transplantation: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12469574.creator: Nives Nikpalj, Jure Samardžić, Nada Božina, Livija Šimičević, Lana Ganoci, Tamara Božina
pmc-12469574.description: Background: Tacrolimus is a cornerstone of immunosuppressive therapy following heart transplantation. Despite routine therapeutic drug monitoring (TDM), substantial interindividual variability in tacrolimus pharmacokinetics presents a persistent challenge. Pharmacogenetic profiling—particularly of CYP3A5 and CYP3A4 polymorphisms—offers a promising approach to individualize tacrolimus dosing and improve clinical outcomes.

pmc-12472035.title: Electromagnetism in Linear, Homogeneous and Isotropic Materials: The Analogy Between Electricity and Magnetism in the Susceptibility and Polarization
pmc-12472035.creator: Dimosthenis Stamopoulos, Jianbo Yin
pmc-12472035.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Through the years, the asymmetry in the constitutive relations that define the electric and magnetic polarization, P and M, respectively, by the relevant vector field, E and H, has been imprinted, rather arbitrarily, in Maxwell’s equations. Accordingly, in linear, homogeneous, and isotropic (LHI) materials, the electric and magnetic polarization are defined via P = χeε0E (‘P-E, χe’ formulation; 0 ≤ χe < ∞) and M = χmH (‘M-H, χm’ formulation; −1 ≤ χm < ∞), respectively.

pmc-12473667.title: Emerging Approaches for the Discovery of Lipid-Based RNA Delivery Systems
pmc-12473667.creator: Paul Meers
pmc-12473667.description: This brief review is a non-comprehensive look at some of the important aspects of lipidic nucleic acid delivery systems with a focus on RNA. In the context of this review on lipid-based formulation, nucleic acids are one of the key cargoes.

pmc-12582534.title: Predicting Postoperative Stress Urinary Incontinence After Prolapse Surgery via Machine Learning and Regression Models: Development and Validation Study
pmc-12582534.creator: Minna Su, Shuyu Wang, Xiaochun Liu
pmc-12582534.description: BackgroundPelvic organ prolapse (POP) and stress urinary incontinence (SUI) often concurrently exist. The incontinence in some patients with POP resolves after POP surgery, but it persists in others. Some patients without SUI before surgery may develop de novo SUI. It is unclear whether a concomitant anti-incontinence procedure should be performed at the time of POP surgery to prevent postoperative incontinence.

pmc-12623387.title: Association of plasma carnitine levels with bone mineral density and recent osteoporotic fracture
pmc-12623387.creator: Zhaoyue Shang, Xinwei Wang, Yongliang Du, Xiaohua Zhang, Yanlin Duan, William D. Leslie, Lisa M. Lix, Bo Kan, Shuman Yang
pmc-12623387.description: BackgroundThe carnitine system may play an essential role in bone metabolism. However, existing epidemiological studies on the association between carnitine and bone mineral density (BMD) are still controversial. No human study has examined the association of carnitine and osteoporotic fracture. The objective of this research was to examine the association of carnitine levels with BMD and recent osteoporotic fracture.

pmc-12982123.title: Scaffolds with optimized quaternary symmetry for de novo cryoEM structure determination of small RNAs
pmc-12982123.creator: Christopher P. Jones, Adrian R. Ferré-D’Amaré
pmc-12982123.description: Structured RNAs play many roles in cells and emerging biotechnology. While large RNAs and ribonucleoprotein complexes often benefit from high-resolution structural analysis through cryogenic-sample electron microscopy (cryoEM), single-domain RNAs, particularly those smaller than ~100 nt (33 kDa), have proven challenging.

pmc-13028558.title: Pan-Immune-Inflammation Value as a Novel Predictor of Contrast-Associated Acute Kidney Injury in Patients Treated with Primary PCI for STEMI
pmc-13028558.creator: Gökhan Çiçek, Sadık Kadri Açıkgöz, Eser Açıkgöz, Servet Altay
pmc-13028558.description: Background/Objectives: Contrast-associated acute kidney injury (CA-AKI) remains an important cause of morbidity and mortality in patients undergoing procedures that require intravascular contrast administration. Therefore, the early identification of high-risk individuals is paramount, above all for ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) patients in need of urgent percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI).

pmc-13077565.title: Development and Qualification of a Pseudotyped Virus‐Based Microneutralisation Assay for Influenza D Virus
pmc-13077565.creator: Maria Giovanna Marotta, Tobias Mapulanga, Meshach Maina, Janet Daly, Michele Camero, Pauline Mvan Diemen, Helen E Everett, Emanuele Montomoli, Kelly da Costa, Nigel Temperton, Claudia Maria Trombetta
pmc-13077565.description: BackgroundEpidemiological surveillance of influenza D virus (IDV) has gained increased priority following recent serological findings indicating its potential zoonosis in humans. In this context, it is crucial to develop strong, reproducible, reliable and scalable immunological assays that can be quickly implemented in the surveillance of new emerging threats.

pmc-13286246.title: Krill Oil for Pain in Elders: protocol for a pilot, double-blind, randomised controlled trial to evaluate the efficacy of 4 g/d krill oil supplementation for chronic musculoskeletal pain and mobility limitations in older adults
pmc-13286246.creator: Javier A. Tamargo, Katarina Simic, Samira Capote, Rene Przkora, Kimberly T. Sibille, Yenisel Cruz-Almeida, Steve D. Anton
pmc-13286246.description: Mobility limitations due to chronic musculoskeletal pain are a major contributor to disability in older adults, yet current pharmacological treatments often have limited efficacy and increase the risk of polypharmacy. Omega (ω)-3 PUFA, particularly EPA and DHA, have demonstrated anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties, but are under-consumed among older USA adults.

pmc-13333461.title: Clinical features, etiological spectrum, and outcomes of neurological patients initially presenting with psychiatric symptoms
pmc-13333461.creator: Chao Chen, Yiya Xu, Zixiong Zhan, Yingchao He, Shifu Xiao, Ting Chen

pmc-13382146.title: Clinical characteristics of nontuberculous mycobacterial infections among people with presumptive tuberculosis in India: a multicenter study (2021–2025)
pmc-13382146.creator: Surendra Kumar Sharma, Vishwanath Upadhyay, Alladi Mohan, Ravindra Kumar Dewan, Rajesh Solanki, Kamal Kishore Chopra, Babaji Ghewade, Digambar Behera, Ravindra Mohan Pandey, Ajoy Kumar Verma, Ashish Ranjan, Raj Narayan Yadav, Kaushal Kumar Dwivedi, Pranav Patel, Rangineni Jayaprada, Kusum Sharma, Ja
pmc-13382146.description: SummaryBackgroundDisease caused by nontuberculous mycobacteria (NTM) is often misdiagnosed as tuberculosis (TB) in India. Comprehensive studies on NTM are lacking, therefore, the present study aimed to describe clinical features, underlying conditions, species distribution, and treatment outcomes of NTM disease among people with presumptive TB (individuals with symptoms suggestive of TB) in India.

pmc-13400970.title: Vaccination Coverage and Prevention Counselling for Vaccine‐Preventable STIs Among HIV PrEP Users in São Paulo, Brazil: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13400970.creator: Marjorie Marini Rapozo, Amanda Nazareth Lara, Victor Cabelho Passarelli, Laísa Rivas Dapousa Ramos, Patricia Silva Montes, Camila de Melo Picone, Angela Carvalho Freitas
pmc-13400970.description: IntroductionHIV pre‐exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) users may be disproportionately vulnerable to sexually transmitted infections (STIs) in general, including several that are vaccine‐preventable. Understanding immunization patterns in this population is, therefore, crucial. However, data on vaccination coverage among Brazilian PrEP users remains limited.

pmc-13538633.creator: Rodolfo Mastropasqua, Maria Ludovica Ruggeri, Alberto Quarta, Ruggero Tartaro, Corina Valentina de Sanctis Ciacci, Letizia Pelusi, Mario Nubile
pmc-13538633.description: available techniques primarily aim at anatomical closure without consistently achieving functional recovery [1].
